Original Hugo Desk demonstration illustrations: Forest, Coast, and Mountains.
Created from geometric shapes specifically for this project; no downloaded
artwork, photographs, or third-party reference assets are used.

License: MIT, the same as the Hugo Desk project.
Rebuild source: scripts/generate-demo-images.py (requires Pillow).

The Mountains image uses a Unicode filename in gallery/ to exercise nested
bundle assets and Unicode paths. The article is original demo copy.
